item.title: Carney says Canadian values key to sovereignty, pushes back on Trump's remarks
item.description: QUÉBEC — Staying true to Canada's core values will be key to upholding its sovereignty, Prime Minister Mark Carney said in a speech Thursday which also pushed back against recent comments by U.S. President Donald Trump.

item.title: Trump withdraws Carney's invitation to 'Board of Peace'
Quebec pushes back greenhouse gas reduction target by five years to 2035
item.description: QUÉBEC — The Quebec government announced Thursday that it's pushing back its greenhouse gas reduction target by five years to protect the economy and jobs, as environmental groups warned that the delay could have serious consequences down the line.

item.title: Some Kashechewan First Nation residents test positive for parasite amid evacuation
item.description: At least 28 people from a northern Ontario First Nation that was largely evacuated after the failure of its water system have tested positive for a parasite that causes gastrointestinal illness, community officials said.

item.title: Myles Gray police-beating death hearing in B.C. adjourned due to hot-mic obscenity
item.description: VANCOUVER — A public hearing into the 2015 police beating death of Myles Gray that got underway in Vancouver this week has been adjourned because a lawyer used a strong obscenity to describe someone in a remark captured by a microphone.

item.title: Japan's Takaichi dissolves parliament after only 3 months in office, setting up snap election
item.description: TOKYO (AP) — Japan’s Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi dissolved the lower house of Parliament on Friday, paving the way for a Feb. 8 snap election.
